question: Which starlit orchard will you harvest your heart's desire?
intro_environment: A sweeping vista of drifting celestial orchards, nebula clouds, and starlit cliffs, with a tiny couple exploring in the distance.
intro_couple_action: The couple hovers on a small cloud, hand in hand, gazing at the luminous horizon

choices.title: Nebula Orchard
choices.description: Floating islands studded with luminous vines and crystal treehouses, set against a violet nebula sky.
choices.composition: Clustered treehouses on floating islands, vines draped over edges, with a distant starfield.
choices.camera: Low-angle sweeping shot from below, capturing the floating islands and the couple climbing a vine.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep violet, teal, and silver starlight
choices.couple_action: The couple gently climbs a vine between two treehouses, lanterns bobbing beside them

choices.title: Aurora Meadow
choices.description: A vast floating meadow of bioluminescent flowers and a glowing path, set amid pastel pinks and blues.
choices.composition: Wide meadow with a single glowing path winding through luminous flowers, horizon line low.
choices.camera: High-angle drone view slightly above the meadow, showing the couple strolling along the path.
choices.couple_action: The couple strolls hand in hand along the glowing path, watching petals light up

choices.title: Astral Observatory
choices.description: A tall crystalline tower with a glass dome, surrounded by floating stone, overlooking a starry expanse.
choices.composition: Crystalline tower centered, glass dome reflecting stars, with floating stone platforms around.
choices.camera: Medium side shot focusing on the dome and the couple peering through a telescope
choices.couple_action: The couple peers through a telescope, pointing at a bright constellation

choices.title: Aurora Cliffs
choices.description: Jagged cliffs overlooking a swirling nebula sea, a small lantern drifting above the horizon.
choices.composition: Jagged cliffs at the foreground, nebula sea below, comet streaking across the sky.
choices.camera: Wide shot from cliff edge capturing horizon and comet
choices.dominant_palette: Deep indigo, emerald green, amber glow
choices.couple_action: The couple stands on the cliff edge, watching a comet streak across the nebula sea
